name: March of Sacrifices
summary: The March of Sacrifices is a dungeon shaped around the theme of Hircine's Great Hunt. It is part of the Wolfhunter DLC, along with Moon Hunter Keep. The entrance can be found at a Hircine statue southwest of Serpent's Grotto in Greenshade. Spectral animals such as goats, herons and springboks can be found within. The following item sets will drop in the dungeon: Hanu's Compassion, Blood Moon, Haven of Ursus, and Balorgh.
